result.reason: The 30-day non-renewal period and 60-day Vendor reminder meet the preferred renewal mechanics, but the clause omits the required price-increase cap and therefore does not fully reach either the preferred or fallback position. The edits are otherwise targeted and preserve the annual renewal structure and reciprocal termination rights. Drafting quality is weakened because, after inserting the renewal-reminder sentence, “Such notice” appears to refer to HDI’s renewal reminder rather than the non-renewal notice, illogically requiring the reminder to specify a Termination Date.
